content:
marta_fin: Heads-up 1: Polaris Labs (acct 5081) dispute on INV-2026-089 for $14,250. AP requests a one-time hardship discount and a Net-60 to avoid suspension; they cite a bridge loan delay.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-089 issued 2026-03-10; due 2026-04-09. PDF: https://billing.redwood/invoices/INV-2026-089.pdf

sam_collections: I pulled their usage. Nothing anomalous on our side; this looks like true cashflow strain from the customer's note. They propose 20% discount if they pay the remainder within 60 days.

paul_csm: Polaris is on our growth program; we're seeing increased embeddings volume next quarter. Losing them would hurt momentum. Would prefer a short-term concession if we can protect AR.

rebecca_fin: Finance policy: standalone discounts >15% need VP approval + sign-off from legal. Net-60 on a new invoice is okay if credit check passes.

legal-ops: Addendum required for any discount >10%. Also need a clause that discount is void if customer files for bankruptcy or misses the Net-60 payment. We can draft a short amendment.

accounting_ops: Operational note: if we grant Net-60, we need a collection hold release in our AR system and a specific reminder schedule (30/45/55 days). We can set automated dunning emails but want manager okay first.

sam_collections: Proposed compromise: Offer 12% hardship credit ($1,710) if they pay 50% within 21 days and the remaining 50% within 60 days. Must sign amendment and provide proof of loan timeline. If they miss any payment, discount is void and late fees apply.

marta_fin: That seems reasonable. @rebecca_fin can you fast-track VP approval for 12%? Also ask legal to include the void clause and a clause requiring a contact for payments.

rebecca_fin: I'll ping @vp_finance now. If VP approves, accounting_ops can issue amended invoice with net dates and the reduced amount. VP usually replies within same business day.

legal-ops: Draft language suggestion below (please review):

```
Amendment - INV-2026-089
1) One-time hardship credit of 12% applied to invoice total ($1,710) contingent on Customer making an initial payment of 50% ($6,270) within 21 days of signing.
2) Remaining balance due within 60 days of signing.
3) Credit is void if Customer fails to make either payment on time or if Customer files for insolvency/bankruptcy.
4) Customer must provide written evidence of funding delay and an expected funding date within 5 business days of signing.
```

sam_collections: Also recommend adding a payment method block: ACH only for the first payment to reduce card dispute risk.

paul_csm: I'll pass this to Polaris and frame it as support to keep them online while they bridge funding. I'll ask for the funding timeline doc and confirm they can do ACH.

accounting_ops: Once legal confirms wording, I will create amended invoice and set dunning schedule: reminder@30d, escalation@60d. Note: we still charge standard late fee if they miss payments.

marta_fin: OK. If VP approves, proceed. If VP declines, propose Net-30 with smaller credit (5%) and expedited payment plan.

billing-bot: Case logged: COL-2026-066 for Polaris Labs acct 5081.

rebecca_fin: VP approved 12% hardship credit conditionally pending legal final text. @legal-ops please finalize and I'll route to accounting.

legal-ops: Final text ready; uploaded to drafts: https://drive.redwood/drafts/polaris-amendment-5081.docx. Accounting, please prepare amended invoice for signature.

sam_collections: Sent proposed amendment to customer via Paul. Customer acknowledged and will try to initiate ACH by 2026-04-06.

marta_fin: Great. Keep monitoring. If ACH doesn't land by 2026-04-08, we'll trigger the fallback plan (Net-30 + 5% credit).

paul_csm: Polaris confirmed ACH initiated but bank may take 3 business days. They asked for a short confirmation email once we see the deposit.

accounting_ops: We'll watch bank feeds and post updates in this thread. Scheduling reminders at 30/45/55 once amendment is signed.

marta_fin: Thanks everyone. Watchlist open for 10 days; if payments clear, close case. If not, escalate per fallback path.
